marta: Quick kickoff for the Dedicated listing. Main goals: clear trial behavior, simple SKU naming for buyers, and manifest ready for publisher UI.

liam: Suggest friendly names: Dedicated Starter / Pro / Enterprise. Internal SKUs: D-START / D-PRO / D-ENT. Trial = D-TRIAL-30. Keep public copy short.

sophie: Legal check: trial must explicitly state 'no SLA, no guaranteed capacity' and require opt-in to convert. We'll need consent proof (email or checkbox + timestamp). I'll draft wording.

grant: Ops note: trial defaults: autoscale=false, kms_key=null, max_tpm=5000, max_concurrency=2. We'll include a tiny terraform snippet in quickstart and link to full repo.

liam: For billing we publish two dimensions: tokens and capacity_hours. Trial meters tokens for telemetry but doesn't bill. Manifest example in tracker.

mp-bot: Reminder: publisher manifest must include support_url, contact_email, and tax_id. See publisher docs at https://console.marketplace/requirements

marta: Action items: Sophie to post consent copy by Tue, Grant to push quickstart + terraform snippet by Thu, Liam to update manifest and add region_restrictions for GovCloud by Fri. We'll review Fri 9am.

grant: Pushed draft quickstart: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/quickstarts/dedicated-trial-v1.md (please review).

liam: I'll assemble manifest fragment and add trial_caps section.

sophie: Draft consent posted in tracker, includes checkbox text and email workflow.

marta: Great, thanks team. Ping here with any blockers and I'll update the onboarding tracker.
